title: Particle VAE (Categorical Posterior) Fidelity & KL Identity
intuition: Tests a genuine particle VAE with categorical posterior routing on two separated modes: requires low reconstruction MSE (<= 0.05), high shuffle-reconstruction ratio (>= 5.0), non-collapsed mutual information (>= 0.30), calibrated posterior noise variance, and exact KL identity (<= 1e-5).
failure_mode: Posterior collapse causes the decoder to ignore the encoder (low shuffle ratio / MI) or breaks the analytic KL divergence identity.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required public-API model task (1,200 updates).
